name: card
description: A command-line business card for your domain, served by a Cloudflare Worker
author: Xat <i@xat.sh>(https://xat.sh)

BROWSER_HTTPS_REDIRECT.description: `true` redirects browsers from `http://` to `https://` while `curl` keeps getting the card over plain HTTP.

ORIGIN_PASSTHROUGH.description: `true` when your domain already has a website behind Cloudflare: browsers and other paths go to it. `false` serves a plain-text card instead.
